problem_statement:
Bug#29511118 set_persist_only allows to set a role with system_user privilege

Description:
------------
Check() method specified for the system variable is not called for
SET PERSIST_ONLY option. That is the reason SET PERSIST_ONLY statement succeeds
in this case. However, server restart used to fail with the appropriate error.
This behavior could be problematic in situations when user does not have
access to modify the cnf files directly.

Hence, now the behavior will be -
- Continute to throw error in case of SET GLOBAL/PERSIST mandatory_roles =
'system_user_role'
- Continue to execute SET PERSIST_ONLY mandatory_roles = 'system_user_roles'
- Let the server restart with a warning in case a mandatory_roles is set with a
role that has SYSTEM_USER privilege.
